name: Selous Game Reserve
description: Selous Game Reserve is a vast wilderness in southern Tanzania, covering about 50,000 square kilometres with no permanent human settlement. Its landscape shifts from dense thickets to open grassland and woodland, home to elephants, black rhinoceroses, giraffes, hippos and large crocodiles. Part of it is now Nyerere National Park, and the site is listed as World Heritage in Danger.
